methodology.scope: all stored palette assets, no network or catalog mutation
methodology.exact: Canonical RGBA array; preserve alpha and order, normalize HEX case/shorthand/opaque ff notation
methodology.precision: IEEE-754 double values; no rounding before threshold decisions
methodology.compositing: encoded sRGB source-over opaque #000000 and #ffffff; convert each resulting sRGB composite to OKLab
methodology.nearMatching: all same-count pairs: order and reverse, then optimal one-to-one assignment with maximum-edge constraint
methodology.safeLowerBounds: black/white centroid norm and symmetric nearest-color distance; never arbitrary top-N or sampled comparisons
methodology.grouping: near results are pairs only; no transitive closure or chain collapsing
methodology.confidenceScope: High confidence describes the measured relation, not a human claim of visual indistinguishability or permission to delete distinct author tokens
methodology.interpretation: Same multiset/reverse/permutation, subsets and author size variants retain order/count semantics and are not automatic removals
limitations: Palette-only numeric audit; no perceptual browser or human color-judgment claim
